name: Sketch
description: Mark places, draw and point out routes and areas on the table from a phone

about.purpose: Lets everyone contribute: people mark places, routes and areas on the table from their phones.
questions: Where do you go, and what would you change?
Which places feel unsafe, loved or missing?
limits: There is no voting or commenting on each other's marks yet

controls.label: Take back my last mark
controls.help: From a phone, takes back that phone's last mark; from the controller, the last mark anyone made.
